blocking_findings.title: Direct OpenAPI adapter calls leak YAML ConstructorError for malicious YAML tags
blocking_findings.evidence: OpenAPIAdapter.detect() and OpenAPIAdapter.parse() raised yaml.constructor.ConstructorError for "!!python/object/apply:os.system ['echo nope']". AdapterRegistry catches it as ADAPTER_FAILURE, but the direct adapter API is not fail-closed.

positive_evidence: Editable clean install succeeded after network approval.
pip check reported no broken requirements.
Mutation script reported 17/17 caught against production seams.
Wheel built and installed into second clean environment from local wheelhouse.
CLI smoke for agentnative, scan, protocols, capabilities, owner, and policy passed.
Wheel contains no v2core or agentnative_v2 package entries.
